sources.snippet: The model has a 1M context window and can now run locally via Unsloth Dynamic GGUFs with llama.cpp or Unsloth Desktop. GLM-5.3-Flash GuideGLM-5.3 Guide If you want to run GLM-5.3-Flash, please read our specific article for it. Dynamic 1-bit GGUF reaches ~76% top-1 accuracy while being 85% smaller.

sources.title: How to Run GLM-5.3-Flash Locally: GGUF, Hardware and Benchmarks
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash is the first natively multimodal model in Z.ai's GLM-5 series, and the first one that's realistic to run locally: it has 320B total parameters and 18B active per token. This guide covers what the model is, how it performs in the benchmarks, how much memory you'll need to run it, and what your options are for running it today.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash: Frontier Intelligence, Flash Cost - z.ai
sources.snippet: We introduce GLM-5.3-Flash, the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series. With 320B total parameters and just 18B active parameters, it outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world workloads at one-tenth the price, while approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks.
